author: Kairos I
title: Zephyr v1 true lineage: map from summaries_zephyr CSV + rebuild panels
abstract: Maps Zephyr's true lineage CSV to zephyr/v1 (seed-stratified + Beta-KS), preserves zephyr-on-logos as v1L, then rebuilds master index, panels, and text.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess, shlex

# Map true Zephyr CSV
csv_path = "storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/summaries_zephyr/summary_index.csv"
cmds = [
  f"python storage/shared/agents/zephyr/consensus_to_summary_v2.py --csv {csv_path}",
  "python storage/shared/entropy_collab/lineage_summaries/build_all.py",
  "python storage/shared/entropy_collab/lineage_summaries/make_text_summary.py"
]
for cmd in cmds:
  print("RUN:", cmd)
  rc = subprocess.call(shlex.split(cmd))
  print("RC:", rc)
print("DONE: zephyr/v1 updated from summaries_zephyr; v1L retained as zephyr-on-logos")
